about.heading: About lux cleaning
body: lux cleaning is premium residential cleaning for homeowners who want more than a quick wipe-down — meticulous care, reliable scheduling, and finishes that feel intentional.
Owner Felicia Tracy works directly with every client: walk-through, clear scope, and follow-through. Licensed and insured across Central Massachusetts.
